meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能在 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器里用本地命令把附带的 Word、PPT、Excel、PDF 等办公文档转成 Markdown 文本,再阅读或总结,全程不上传文件。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取附带的 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档,并且要求本地转成 Markdown、不经过外部解析服务时。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 add-anydoc,让 agent 能本地转文档。
say.note: 装好 Firecrawl CLI 和转换技能。

say.text: 检查容器里有没有 anydoc,没有就装。
say.note: 会先核对 manifest,再决定是否安装。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use a local CLI inside NanoClaw agent containers to convert attached office documents (Word, PPT, Excel, PDF, etc.) to Markdown, then read or summarize them without uploading files.
howto.when_en: When agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, or similar office files and require local conversion to Markdown without sending files to a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Add add-anydoc to NanoClaw so agents can convert documents locally.
say_en.note: Installs the Firecrawl CLI and the conversion skill.

say_en.text: Install add-anydoc and verify Word and PDF convert to Markdown.
say_en.note: Runs a smoke test to confirm conversion works.

say_en.text: Check if anydoc is in the container; install it if missing.
say_en.note: Checks the manifest first, then installs if needed.
